page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc-8x.64xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 256 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9A75 processors running at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU configuration provides 256 physical cores with a single thread per core. The system is equipped with 1536.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 6.0 GB per core.

This instance integrates eight NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, delivering a combined total of 576 GB of VRAM. For network connectivity, the server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 200 Gbps. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached storage options. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile represents a high-density accelerator class, trading off local storage for massive parallel compute capacity and high-speed networking. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the consolidation of eight Blackwell GPUs and 256 dedicated physical cores within a single instance reduces multi-node orchestration overhead for large-scale workloads. This configuration is designed for workloads such as large language model training, complex deep learning inference, high-fidelity graphics rendering, and parallel scientific simulations.
